## What's new

- **Search grows out of the search button.** Tap the round search button and it stretches to the left into the search field, right in the bar, while the tabs fold into a single button that takes you back to where you were. The field moves up with the keyboard, so it stays under your thumb while you type — no more field at the top with the search icon still left at the bottom. Choosing Search starts typing straight away, and what you typed is kept while you look at other tabs. On iOS 26 this is the system's own liquid glass search tab; on iOS 17 to 18 Kultr's floating glass bar does the same.

## Install

Download **Kultr.ipa** below and install it with **Sideloadly** (Windows, Mac), **AltStore** (Windows, Mac) or **Impactor** (Linux). New to this? Follow the step-by-step guide: https://github.com/evropiani/Kultr_iOS/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md

Installing over an earlier version keeps your servers, library, listening history, analysis and downloads — install it with the same Apple ID and don't delete the old app first.
